# omadafusion_time_range (Resource)

A time-range profile (Profiles > Time Range). Used by WLAN schedules and ACLs. Changes are applied in place, so a profile can be edited while an SSID schedule uses it. The controller's day mode is derived from `days`: all seven days is Every Day, mon-fri is Weekday, sat+sun is Weekend, and anything else is Customized with the same periods on each selected day.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "omadafusion_time_range" "business_hours" {
  name    = "Business hours"
  days    = ["mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri"]
  periods = [{ start = "07:30", end = "18:00" }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `days` (Set of String) Days the periods apply to: any of `mon`, `tue`, `wed`, `thu`, `fri`, `sat`, `sun`.
- `name` (String) Profile name. Must be unique in the site.
- `periods` (Attributes List) On-intervals, in the site's time zone. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--periods))

### Optional

- `site` (String) Site name or ID. Defaults to the provider `site`. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Time range ID.

<a id="nestedatt--periods"></a>
### Nested Schema for `periods`

Required:

- `end` (String) End time, `HH:MM` (`24:00` allowed).
- `start` (String) Start time, `HH:MM`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id> or <site>/<id>
terraform import omadafusion_time_range.business_hours Default/64f0c0ffee00000000000001
```
